blocks.text: Vessel volume alone is inadequate. Extraction requires mixing and heat transfer in the actual viscous liquor; precipitation needs ethanol addition that avoids locally concentrated, difficult-to-wash clumps; separators need a balance of supernatant retained in wet cake and associated marker losses. Recycled ethanol strength becomes a process input because water/alcohol composition changes selectivity.[12] Define equipment acceptance through target-fraction recovery, cleaning and solvent closure, not simply successful mechanical operation.

en.heading: Applications: clarity, sensory quality and retained composition can conflict

blocks.text: Polysaccharide-oriented beverages and triterpenoid-oriented concentrates require different development paths. For ambient-water instant powders, measure wetting, reconstituted insolubles and vertical marker distribution at the actual dose. For clear beverages, define acceptable target-fraction losses: removing particles or aggregates does not automatically preserve extract composition. Triterpenoid fractions should be screened for bitterness, precipitation and carrier needs. Their profiles can differ between Ganoderma materials, so sensory and dispersion experience with one material is not a genus-wide property.[9]

R&D should blind-test water extract, triterpenoid-related fraction and a measured blend separately at equal target-component dose, with an extract-free formulation blank. Engineering should measure solids and beta-glucan/triterpenoid-related attributes before and after filtration so improved clarity is associated with a quantified loss. Procurement should disclose starch-containing carriers and their effects on alpha-glucan interpretation rather than calculating target components from total powder mass. Brand language should focus on verified provenance, fraction, flavour and dispersion; an evening-drink concept does not itself establish a sleep benefit.

Capsules shift the brief toward target-component loading per unit volume, flow and within-batch uniformity. Concentrated liquids require attention to physical changes after thermal processing and opening. Proposed tests should use actual packaging and pair whole-container redispersed samples with supernatant samples. Record viscosity increase, precipitation and darkening separately rather than hiding distinct mechanisms behind one “stability passed” statement. Application acceptance windows should follow the product brief, not an in-vitro antioxidant concentration converted into a food dose.

en.heading: Standards and QA: total polysaccharides, total glucans and beta-glucan are different quantities

blocks.text: The co-extraction paper measured polysaccharides by the phenol–sulfuric acid method against D-glucose and triterpenoids by the vanillin–glacial acetic acid method against ursolic acid, expressing the latter as ursolic-acid equivalents.[12] Accordingly, 0.63% is not a beta-glucan recovery and 0.38% is not an HPLC-confirmed sum of ganoderic acids. A contract comparing colour-reaction equivalents directly with named chromatographic analytes can create an apparent price difference driven by assay choice rather than material quality.

McCleary and Draga's mushroom/mycelial-product method uses controlled sulfuric-acid hydrolysis and glucose-specific detection for the total-glucan-related measurement, a separate enzymatic channel for alpha-glucan and relevant free-sugar contributions, and calculates beta-glucan by difference. Their abstract reports higher values with sulfuric acid than the compared hydrochloric-acid procedure for certain samples including G. lucidum and Poria, and generally lower results from fully enzymatic hydrolysis.[5] A COA therefore needs more than “beta-glucan method”: fix the version, preparation, acid-hydrolysis conditions, alpha-channel treatment and dry/as-is basis. Resolve laboratory disagreements through retained samples, common methods, parallel digestion and suitable spikes/reference samples rather than choosing the higher result.

Alpha-glucan alone does not establish adulteration with starch; beta-glucan by difference does not establish species, fruiting-body provenance or absence of substrate. Identity and supply-chain evidence answer a different question from compositional quantification.[5][9] A proposed QA hierarchy includes species and part, matrix disclosure, beta/alpha-glucans and any necessary total-sugar measurement, triterpenoid fingerprint and agreed individual markers, moisture, microbiology, relevant contaminants and used solvents. Dedicated triterpenoid specifications need suitable reference standards and chromatographic confirmation, not a subjective bitterness threshold.

For US dietary-supplement manufacture, 21 CFR 111.70 requires component identity and necessary purity, strength, composition and contaminant limits, as well as appropriate process and finished-product specifications.[13] That is a legal basis for a control system, not a universal beta-glucan or triterpenoid percentage for reishi. Foods, supplements, medicines, spore oils and new fractions cannot be treated identically because they share a reishi name. Naming the exact material and destination in a contract is more actionable than an undefined “pharmacopoeial grade.”

en.heading: Research and failure diagnosis: optimize selectivity and structure, not only powder yield

blocks.text: Revisit the joint optimization objective first. The 2020 study gave the two fractions equal weights and obtained lower joint yields than the respective conventional controls. A beta-glucan-led product may need a different objective.[12] Define target-component mass, accompanying composition, solvents and cost, then compare water extraction, alcohol extraction, sequential extraction and blending. Engineering should document stream volumes and recovery energy; procurement should compare cost per accepted target component rather than powder yield. Add a glucan-specific method so a total-sugar response does not optimize unwanted small sugars.

A second programme should investigate molecular-weight distribution and structural preservation. Breaking a macromolecule can leave a similar total-sugar colour response while changing viscosity and reconstitution; measure the distribution and appropriate structural attributes rather than assuming stronger ultrasound is better. The paper's DPPH and reducing-power tests are in-vitro chemical measurements, not predictions of food-mediated immune outcomes.[12] Future cell studies should characterize purity, proteins/coextractives and endotoxin controls so a response is not assigned to an undefined “reishi polysaccharide.” These are research-design recommendations, not results for a commercial material.

Four actionable failure paths follow. High total sugar but low beta-glucan calls for checking method, carrier and starting part before increasing extraction temperature. Acceptable triterpenoids in liquor but not precipitated powder calls for assaying supernatant and washings, not simply adding more raw material. A working bath-scale experiment that fails in a tank calls for actual thermal history, delivered energy and solids suspension measurements, not linear replication of 210 W. Better taste after filtration with lower marker assay calls for paired cake/filtrate analysis and a deliberate formulation or composition decision. Each path generates a specific R&D experiment, engineering record, QA method and procurement criterion.

zh.heading: 工艺：白参、红参、黑参不是由总皂苷数字定义的三个等级

blocks.text: 白参通常由鲜Panax ginseng根干燥制得，红参经过受控蒸制，黑参则在白参或红参基础上多次蒸制；2024年红参植物化学综述把这些加工身份与各自化学谱联系起来，同时指出红参还含美拉德反应产物等非皂苷组分。[15] 因此三者不是同一提取物简单按“浓度从低到高”排序。采购应先固定P. ginseng根部、起始鲜/干状态和蒸干历史，再比较提取物；不能把人参叶、三七P. notoginseng或越南参P. vietnamensis的热处理结果直接替代人参根证据。

第一阶段是加工决定化学，而不是提取罐决定全部化学。部分丙二酰基皂苷受热可转成相应中性皂苷，随后糖基脱除及脱水又可生成低极性皂苷。研究发现热处理时主要皂苷Rg1、Re、Rb1等下降，Rg3的两种构型以及Rk1、Rg5等增加，但变化速度受基质中的有机酸影响。[3] 因而仅检测蒸前蒸后某一个中性皂苷的“增幅”，可能只看到了丙二酰基形式转为中性形式，不能据此声称总皂苷质量无中生有地增加。研发应同时看主要前体、相应转化产物和干基质量平衡；涉及脱糖转化时可增加摩尔量核算，避免分子量变化使质量收率被误读。

一项可追溯的机制实验使用2013年在韩国曾坪采购的四年生人参：洗净后在−18°C冻结24小时、冻干并锤磨。作者将原参粉和分离得到的粗皂苷粉分别各取0.5 g，置于带盖玻璃瓶，各加3.0 mL水，在130°C油浴中加热1–5小时。[3] 这不是整支鲜根的工业蒸柜实验，也不是经过商业干燥的普通白参粉。原参中有机酸总量测为5.55%，未加热粗皂苷中未检出有机酸；原参主要皂苷在130°C加热1小时后几乎全部转为文中所列次要皂苷，粗皂苷变化较慢。[3] 工程可由此获得“基质化学控制反应速度”的假设，但不能把这个时间温度当成整根红参标准操作。
作者还用100 μL、0.5 mM的Rb1溶液配合2 mM柠檬酸、苹果酸或琥珀酸，在封闭微毛细玻璃管中130°C处理1小时。没有有机酸的水中Rb1相对稳定，有酸时则生成脱糖/脱水产物，包含Rg3(S)、Rg3(R)、Rk1与Rg5。[3] 这个对照把“高温本身”与“高温加酸”分开，是比单独一条工艺得率更有用的证据。建议红参加工记录同时包含水分、可提取酸或滴定酸度、温度时间，而不是只记录蒸了几遍。

第二阶段才是溶剂提取与必要富集。上述论文为了制备研究用粗皂苷，采用40 mL 80%乙醇、40°C超声30分钟等步骤，之后水溶、乙醚脱脂、正丁醇分配与冻干；该段未明确给出起始人参装样质量，不能据此计算完整液固比或推算产能。[3] 这些分析/分离用溶剂也不应原样移植成食品工艺。商业开发宜先以目标市场允许的水/乙醇体系比较选定皂苷谱、非皂苷伴随物、固形物回收和味道；若用树脂分级，应额外报告吸附、洗脱和清洗阶段的各股标志物，明确它已经改变原本根提取物的组成。
第三阶段的浓缩和干燥可能继续改变组分。机制实验显示同一类皂苷在含酸基质中更易受热转化，因此建议将浓缩温度、实际料温、停留时间、进料酸度和干燥前后指纹串联记录。[3] 如果项目需要保留传统白参主皂苷谱，就应避免把热浓缩变成未经定义的第二次加工；如果需要特定转化皂苷，则要设置反应终点，而非无限延长热处理。不同目标对应不同生产窗口，不能共用“越深色越好”的验收语言。

blocks.text: 整根蒸柜验收的建议重点是根芯而非面板温度：根径分级和装盘厚度影响冷点达到条件的时间，同样“保温两小时”可能对应不同有效热暴露。取样应在已测温位置成对进行，使色谱变化能够对应真实热史。提取罐则不应继续承担未经定义的蒸制职责；先制备身份明确的根材料，再讨论提取，才能把“换了原料加工”与“改变了溶剂”两种影响拆开。
对于稀有皂苷富集项目，建议让反应设备与产品名称同时重新定义。高温酸处理产生的特定谱，不应仅凭颜色叫作任何传统红参规格；品牌叙述需要与实际工艺一致。研究用密闭毛细管能快速达到反应温度，而满载釜需要升温、混合和冷却，放大时应按实际反应历程和终点组分设计，不按实验保温时间照抄。

zh.heading: 应用：饮料配方本身可能成为下一个加工步骤

blocks.text: 酸性饮料不只是把人参粉稀释。机制研究在130°C的密闭模型中显示有机酸促进皂苷转化；这不足以量化常规饮料杀菌条件下的转换程度，却明确指出pH/有机酸与热历史值得一起测试。[3] 建议在目标饮料中对杀菌前、杀菌后和储存后分别测主要皂苷与Rg3/Rk1/Rg5等转化峰，并设置同提取物在无加酸或低热暴露参考体系中的对照。这样能判断标签指标改变来自原料、热工艺还是配方酸，而不是把所有含量下降都归为“原料不稳定”。

白参提取物与红参提取物的口感和颜色开发也应分开。综述指出蒸制产生的非皂苷成分包含美拉德反应产物，因此颜色加深不等于某个皂苷增加。[15] 研发可在相同实测目标皂苷剂量下比较水溶固形物、颜色、土腥/参味、苦味与回味，并以相同总固形物的载体空白辨别甜味剂和壁材影响。对于透明饮料，应测热处理后的浑浊和沉淀；对于浓缩口服液，重点是瓶内均匀性、倒出量一致和容器附着；胶囊项目则关注流动、吸湿与含量均匀性。上述是各用途的开发指标，不预设一个通用添加量。
采购的有效比较单位应是“同加工身份、同方法的目标皂苷质量”，同时显示根提取物总量与载体量。只按总皂苷百分比买货可能把经分级的富集物与全根提取物比较，也可能把不同标志物集合混为一谈。品牌若希望讲述红参工艺，可以展示有记录的蒸干流程和色谱变化；若希望讲述某一稀有皂苷，应建立该单体真实定量，而不是引用另一个物种细胞实验的活性描述。

zh.heading: 标准与QA：写出皂苷名单、制备物与适用类别

blocks.text: EMA于2024年5月29日通过的Panax ginseng根部修订专论，在传统草药药品框架下分别列出白参与红参制备物。白参示例包含DER 3–7:1、40% V/V乙醇提取、含4%皂苷的干提取物，其皂苷明确为Rb1、Rb2、Rc、Rd、Re、Rf、Rg1、Rg2之和；红参示例包含DER 2–4.5:1、60% V/V乙醇的干提取物。[6] 这些DER和溶剂浓度是所列药用制备物的定义，不是本研究推荐工况，也不是所有人参食品都必须或可以采用的规格。
这个八项加和尤其值得QA关注：它没有把Rg3、Rk1、Rg5纳入同一个4%指标。因此一个经热转化后主皂苷下降、稀有皂苷上升的材料，可能在该八项方法下显示降低，但另一个更宽名单的“总量”不同。[3][6] 建议合同附件直接列每个分析物、标准物质、峰识别规则、定量方法、是否区分Rg3(S)/(R)、干基或原样基准以及未知峰处理。使用总皂苷显色法时标明参比物及当量，不把它自动折算成HPLC八项加和。

EMA专论将传统使用适应证限定于相关草药药品，且明确基于长期使用；其正文并非普通食品或饮料的授权。[6] 对品牌而言，植物名称相同不足以把药用剂量、疲劳适应证或相关表述复制到饮料标签。对采购而言，原料根部、白/红/黑参加工方式、提取与分级程度、用途类别应共同进入市场审查。美国膳食补充剂制造可用21 CFR 111.70建立身份、纯度、强度、组成及污染物等规格框架，但该条款不提供一个所有人参通用的“总皂苷合格值”。[13]
质量控制建议分为三个时间点：原料取样保留物种/部位与加工前指纹，蒸干中间体保留前体/产物和水分数据，成品核对浓缩干燥后的比例及载体稀释。若发现总量异常，先查取样均匀性、干基换算、参比物与积分，再追溯工艺；不应先用调配平均值掩盖异常。微生物、适用农残/元素及残留溶剂按材料与市场要求另立检测计划，与皂苷放行并行。

zh.heading: 研究价值与失败：不能只最大化Rg3

blocks.text: 黑参加工研究的机构摘要说明，反复蒸干过程中酸性多糖、多酚、Rg3与苯并芘随条件改变；其响应面优化把目标成分与苯并芘一起考虑。[14] 本次可得材料是研究机构提供的摘要，未核实原始投料与设备规模，因此不把其中“最优温度时间”列为可复现工况。其可靠研究价值在于提示多目标优化：提高一个皂苷并不意味着所有质量维度同步改善；重复加热项目应按实际风险评价热加工污染物，而不是由颜色或蒸制次数推导安全。

最有价值的新研究可用同一批P. ginseng根建立三条对照：低热暴露参考样、受控蒸制样、从同批根获得的皂苷富集分部。记录起始酸度、水分及丙二酰基/中性皂苷，再比较受热后的产物。这样能够检验论文提示的“去掉原料酸后，转化速度改变”，而不是让不同产地、年限和部位掩盖机制。[3] 研发选择有代表性的不同批次重复；工程记录真正料温与停留时间；QA用同一方法检测；采购将稳定性与合格率纳入价格，而非挑一个最漂亮实验批。

失败诊断应具体到反应路径。第一，蒸后Rb1先升后降：检查丙二酰基前体释放与后续脱糖是否先后发生，不急于宣布工艺失控。第二，两批同温同时间但Rg3差异大：比对根径、含水、酸度、装载和根芯热史，而不是只更换检测机构。第三，提取物在饮料热处理后主峰下降：连同Rg3/Rk1/Rg5与沉淀回收一起看，区别化学转化、物理析出和分析提取不足。第四，颜色达标但目标谱不符：用非皂苷褐变与目标反应不同步解释，再调整过程终点而不是继续加深颜色。[3][15]
最终的研究交付不应只有一张总皂苷COA。建议形成根部身份档案、蒸干热史、选定皂苷谱、有机酸或酸度记录、提取物流平衡、浓缩干燥前后变化以及成品矩阵稳定性七项相互连接的数据。对研发，它解释为何这样加工；对工程，它明确何时停止反应；对采购，它定义可比物料；对QA，它提供异常追溯链；对品牌，它提供真实工艺知识，而不需要夸大临床获益。

en.heading: Processes: white, red and black ginseng are not three potency grades

blocks.text: White ginseng is generally prepared by drying fresh Panax ginseng roots, red ginseng by controlled steaming, and black ginseng by repeated steaming of white or red ginseng. A 2024 phytochemical review connects these processing identities to their chemical profiles and discusses non-ginsenoside constituents, including Maillard-reaction products.[15] They are not one extract ordered from low to high concentration. Procurement should first fix P. ginseng root, fresh/dry starting state and steam–dry history. Results for leaves, P. notoginseng or P. vietnamensis must not replace evidence for P. ginseng root.

Processing establishes chemistry before extraction. Heat can convert malonyl ginsenosides into corresponding neutral forms, followed by deglycosylation and dehydration producing less-polar ginsenosides. A mechanistic study found declines in major constituents such as Rg1, Re and Rb1 with increases in compounds including both Rg3 configurations, Rk1 and Rg5; conversion speed depended on organic acids in the matrix.[3] An increase in one neutral ginsenoside may partly represent conversion from a malonyl precursor, not the creation of additional total ginsenoside mass. Follow precursors, products and dry-basis mass balance, adding molar accounting where sugar loss changes molecular weight.

A traceable experiment used four-year-old ginseng purchased in Jeungpyeong, Korea, in 2013. Roots were washed, frozen at −18°C for 24 hours, freeze-dried and hammer-milled. Raw powder and isolated crude-saponin powder were each weighed at 0.5 g into capped glass vials with 3.0 mL water and heated in an oil bath at 130°C for one to five hours.[3] This was not industrial steaming of whole fresh roots or a trial of conventionally dried commercial white-ginseng powder. The raw material contained 5.55% measured organic acids, whereas acids were not detected in unheated crude saponin. Major ginsenosides in raw material were almost completely converted to the reported minor compounds after one hour at 130°C, while crude saponin changed more slowly.[3] The useful engineering hypothesis is matrix-dependent reaction speed, not a standard whole-root steaming recipe.

The authors also heated 100 μL of 0.5 mM Rb1 solution with 2 mM citric, malic or succinic acid in sealed microcapillary glass pipets at 130°C for one hour. Rb1 was relatively stable in water without acids but converted with acids into deglycosylated/dehydrated products including Rg3(S), Rg3(R), Rk1 and Rg5.[3] This separates heat alone from heat-plus-acid more clearly than a single yield figure. Proposed manufacturing records should therefore pair moisture and extractable acids or titratable acidity with time and temperature rather than record only the number of steam cycles.

Solvent extraction and enrichment come next. To prepare experimental crude saponin, the paper used steps including 40 mL 80% ethanol and ultrasound at 40°C for 30 minutes, followed by dissolution in water, ether defatting, n-butanol partitioning and freeze drying. The starting mass for that extraction subsection was not explicit, so a complete liquid-to-solid ratio or capacity cannot be calculated.[3] Analytical/fractionation solvents should not be transferred unchanged into food manufacture. A commercial development programme should compare permitted water/ethanol systems against the selected ginsenoside profile, coextractives, solids recovery and taste. Resin fractionation, if used, needs separate loading, breakthrough, elution and cleaning-stream assays because it changes the original root-extract composition.

Concentration and drying can continue the transformation. Because the mechanistic study shows greater thermal conversion in an acidic matrix, record actual product temperature, residence time, incoming acidity and before/after fingerprints together.[3] A project intended to preserve a white-ginseng major-ginsenoside profile should not allow concentration to become an undefined second processing step. A conversion-product project instead needs a reaction endpoint rather than unlimited heating. Those objectives require different windows and cannot share a “darker is better” criterion.

en.heading: Equipment: distinguish whole-root steaming, extraction and conversion

blocks.text: This is a proposed engineering comparison. The small sealed 130°C experiment supports acid/heat mechanisms, not production capacity or universal equipment settings.[3][15]

Jacketed water/ethanol extractor
Recovers constituents from roots with an already defined processing identity

Vacuum concentration and powder drying

blocks.text: For whole-root steaming, the proposed acceptance focus is core temperature rather than the display setting. Root grading and tray loading affect the time needed for a cold spot to reach the condition. Pair sampling with mapped temperature locations so chemistry is connected to actual exposure. Do not let an extractor silently serve as an additional, undefined steaming operation: use a root material of known identity before changing extraction variables.

For minor-ginsenoside enrichment, redefine both the reaction process and the material description. A high-temperature acid-converted profile should not automatically be called any traditional red-ginseng grade because of its colour. A sealed microcapillary reaches its thermal condition very differently from a loaded reactor, whose heat-up, mixing and cooling contribute to exposure. Scale by measured reaction history and compositional endpoint, not by copying the laboratory holding time.

en.heading: Applications: the beverage can become the next processing step

blocks.text: An acidic beverage is not merely diluted ginseng powder. The 130°C sealed model demonstrates acid-promoted conversion but does not quantify conversion under ordinary beverage sterilization conditions. It does identify pH/organic acids and heat as variables worth testing together.[3] In the target beverage, measure major ginsenosides and conversion peaks such as Rg3/Rk1/Rg5 before processing, after processing and during storage, with a non-acidified or lower-thermal-exposure reference. This distinguishes a raw-material effect from a formulation or thermal-process effect rather than assigning every falling peak to “unstable ingredient.”

White- and red-ginseng sensory/colour briefs should also be separate. The review describes Maillard-reaction products formed during processing, so darker colour is not an assay of any particular ginsenoside.[15] At equal measured marker dose, compare soluble solids, colour, earthy/ginseng notes, bitterness and aftertaste; matched-solids carrier blanks help identify sweetener and carrier effects. Clear beverages need postheat haze/sediment testing; concentrated liquids need bottle uniformity, consistent pour-out and container adhesion; capsules emphasize flow, moisture uptake and content uniformity. These are use-specific development attributes, not one universal inclusion rate.

Procurement should compare marker mass measured by the same method in materials of the same processing identity, while also displaying root-extract mass and carrier mass. Purchasing by “total saponin percentage” alone can compare a fractionated concentrate with a whole-root extract or confuse different analyte sums. A red-ginseng brand story can show documented steam–dry processing and measured profile changes. A story about one minor ginsenoside requires its actual assay, not biological activity quoted from another species.

en.heading: Standards and QA: name the analytes, preparation and legal category

blocks.text: The EMA root monograph adopted on 29 May 2024 lists white- and red-ginseng preparations within the traditional herbal-medicinal-product framework. One white-ginseng example is a dry extract with DER 3–7:1, 40% V/V ethanol and 4% ginsenosides, explicitly the sum of Rb1, Rb2, Rc, Rd, Re, Rf, Rg1 and Rg2. A red-ginseng example is a dry extract with DER 2–4.5:1 and 60% V/V ethanol.[6] These DER and solvent figures define listed medicinal preparations; they are neither recommended experimental operating conditions nor specifications universally required or allowed for ginseng foods.

The eight-component sum excludes Rg3, Rk1 and Rg5. A heat-converted material can therefore fall under that eight-component metric while showing a different result under a broader sum.[3][6] Contracts should list each analyte, reference standard, peak-identification rule, quantification method, treatment of Rg3(S)/(R), dry/as-is basis and handling of unknown peaks. If a colour-reaction total-saponin assay is used, state its reference compound and equivalents rather than automatically converting it into an eight-component HPLC total.

EMA's traditional-use indication belongs to the corresponding herbal medicinal products and is explicitly based on long-standing use; the monograph is not a conventional food or beverage authorization.[6] Sharing a botanical name is insufficient to copy medicinal doses or fatigue wording onto a drink. Market review should connect root identity, white/red/black processing, extraction/fractionation and product category. US dietary-supplement manufacture can use 21 CFR 111.70 as a framework for identity, purity, strength, composition and contaminant specifications, but the section does not provide one universal passing total-ginsenoside percentage.[13]

A proposed quality plan has three checkpoints: incoming identity and pre-processing fingerprint; steam–dry intermediate with precursors/products and moisture; and finished material after concentration/drying and carrier dilution. For an unexpected assay, first inspect sampling, dry-basis conversion, standards and integration, then trace processing. Do not average away an unexplained deviation through blending. Microbiology, relevant pesticides/elements and residual solvents should follow a separate material- and market-specific plan alongside ginsenoside release.

en.heading: Research and failures: do not maximize Rg3 alone

blocks.text: An institutional abstract of black-ginseng optimization describes changes in acidic polysaccharides, polyphenols, Rg3 and benzopyrene with repeated heating and drying, and includes benzopyrene in its response-surface optimization.[14] The available record was an institutional abstract without verified original loading or equipment scale; its reported optimum temperature/time is therefore not presented as a reproducible operating condition here. The defensible research lesson is multi-objective optimization: increasing a selected ginsenoside does not ensure every quality dimension improves. Evaluate thermal-process contaminants according to the actual process risk instead of inferring safety from colour or cycle count.

A valuable new programme could use one P. ginseng root batch to prepare a low-thermal-exposure reference, a controlled-steaming sample and an isolated ginsenoside-rich fraction. Measure initial acidity, moisture and malonyl/neutral profiles, then compare products under heating. This tests the paper's matrix-acid mechanism without letting origin, age and part obscure it.[3] R&D should repeat representative batches; engineering should capture actual product temperature and residence; QA should use one consistent assay; procurement should incorporate stability and acceptance rate, not select only the best experimental batch.

Failure diagnosis should follow reaction paths. Rb1 rising and then falling during steaming calls for checking malonyl-precursor release followed by deglycosylation before declaring loss of control. Different Rg3 results at the same nominal time/temperature call for root-size, moisture, acidity, loading and core-history comparison. Declining beverage peaks after heating call for examining Rg3/Rk1/Rg5 and sediment recovery together to distinguish conversion, precipitation and inadequate analytical extraction. Correct colour with the wrong profile calls for separating non-saponin browning from the target reaction rather than continuing to darken the material.[3][15]

A useful final research dossier therefore connects seven records: root identity, steam–dry history, selected ginsenoside profile, acidity/organic acids, extraction-stream balance, concentration/drying changes and finished-matrix stability. R&D learns why the process works; engineering gains an endpoint; procurement gains comparable materials; QA gains a deviation trail; and the brand gains authentic process knowledge without exaggerated clinical claims.

zh.heading: 工艺：提高目标组分与降低不欲组分必须同时发生

blocks.text: 0. 先定义材料，而不是先购买“24/6”

银杏不是一种可以用单一百分数替代身份的原料。完整或粉碎干叶、普通溶剂叶提取物、经过选择性去杂与定量调整的精制干提取物，以及种仁、外种皮和树皮，是不同研究对象。EMA将干叶粉与特定干提取物分别讨论；二者对应的传统使用依据与临床使用依据也不同，不能把叶提取物的组成和证据搬到种仁或叶茶上。[28] 原始市场质量研究同时分析银杏叶与叶提取物制品，发现有标示提取物而实际更像低浓度叶粉的样品，说明“植物正确”仍不等于“材料正确”。[2]

药典型精制定量干提取物在2018年研究所引用的欧洲药典版本中，黄酮苷为22.0–27.0%，萜内酯为5.4–6.6%，其中银杏内酯A、B、C合计2.8–3.4%，白果内酯2.6–3.2%，银杏酸低于5 ppm；生药与提取物比为35–67:1。[2] 这些是该药典型材料的文献界定，不是所有银杏商品的通用法定范围；“24/6”也不是两种单体的纯度，而是两组不同化学物质的近似含量表达。[2] 采购应以此建立多组分档案：三个主要黄酮苷元的水解前后结果、四个主要萜内酯、银杏酸同系物、其余组分与辅料，而不是把“黄酮更高”自动理解为精制更好。

**路线A：药典型精制材料的公开层级。** 干叶经丙酮/水提取，除去丙酮后继续进行多步选择性处理，去除银杏酸、双黄酮等不需要的部分，并富集黄酮苷与萜内酯。公开质量论文描述某特定工艺包含约18个后续步骤，但没有给出可照搬的完整生产配方；其核心是精制而非一次浸提和喷干。[2] 对工程而言，这意味着设计目标至少有三项：黄酮苷回收、萜内酯回收和银杏酸去除。只用干浸膏得率作优化响应，可能奖励更多糖、盐或不欲脂溶物进入产品。

**路线B：有机构公开记录的乙醇—树脂流程。** EFSA在2021年猫狗饲料添加剂申请评估中记录：干银杏叶在30°C下乙醇长时间提取，离心除去生物质，提取液过吸附黄酮和萜内酯的树脂柱，以乙醇洗脱，蒸发浓缩、喷雾干燥，再加麦芽糊精、粉碎筛分包装。[4] 这是该申请人材料的工艺记录，未披露生产批量、树脂牌号或完整去酸验证；同一意见认为其组成表征不充分，并未认可该饲料用途的安全性。[4] 这个实例的实用价值是让设备与物料流对应起来，而不是证明所有乙醇树脂路线都等同药典型银杏提取物。

**工程建议：把流程拆为六个可测单元。** 第一，干叶验收与切碎应同时记录含水率、原料批次和粒度分布，用均匀混样检测标志物和银杏酸。第二，在夹套提取罐内控制溶剂组成、液固比、温度与接触时间；叶片含水会改变实际醇浓度，回收溶剂不能只凭投料体积配比。第三，离心或过滤时测滤液澄清度与滤渣夹带液，避免把目标物留在湿渣中。第四，精制应对上样液、流穿液、洗涤液和各洗脱段逐段测黄酮苷、萜内酯和银杏酸，建立突破曲线及产品池切割依据。第五，蒸发与干燥前后比较同一干基上的组成和残留溶剂。第六，辅料添加必须进入物料衡算，最终商品粉而非中间无载体浸膏承担标签含量。

**为什么会失效？** 工程判断中，过细粉碎使过滤阻力增大，长时间热接触扩大降解与色泽变化风险，树脂过载和沟流降低分离选择性，过宽的洗脱合并区间会把不欲组分带回产品；这些风险应由本项目的分段分析确认，而不是凭树脂名称排除。建议用“目标组分质量回收率”和“银杏酸去除率”分开报告。例如回收率的分母是该批干叶所含目标组分的质量，不是投料叶重；最终商品浓度还须除以含载体成品总干重。这一算术区分能解释为什么一个粉末含量合格，仍可能有很差的生产经济性。

blocks.text: **胶囊与片剂的工程建议。** 先固定目标商品粉的每份用量，再测松装/振实密度、粒度和吸湿性，随后比较直接混合与制粒。低用量组分混在大粒度差异的辅料中，应采用预混与分层取样评价，而不是仅称胶囊平均重量。若压片后崩解或溶出改变，应追踪黄酮与萜内酯两个组分群，不能只测容易检测的黄酮并假定四种内酯同步释放。配方开发应把含量均匀性和释放作为两个问题处理。
**口服液与复合植物配方。** EFSA申请材料被描述为仅部分溶于水和有机溶剂，提示外观上“能分散”并不等于分子层面全溶。[4] 工程建议在目标pH、离子强度、糖醇体系和真实使用浓度下分别测即时浊度、冷藏析出、加热后沉淀以及过滤前后两组标志物。澄清处理若选择性去除某些组分，液体虽然更漂亮，已经不是原粉的完整化学映射。复合配方还需加一个辅料空白，排查其他植物黄酮对总量结果的贡献。
**品牌内容的有效重点。** 可以解释“叶来源、双标志物组、低水平不欲组分控制、方法可比性”如何关联精制质量，而不把银杏酸去除写成疗效增强的直接证据。EMA对特定干提取物的轻度痴呆相关认知损害/生活质量用途与干叶粉的传统循环症状用途作了区分。[28] 合适的科学叙述应保留具体材料和终点，这比笼统的“改善记忆”更有知识价值。

en.heading: Process: recovery and unwanted-constituent removal must occur together

blocks.text: 0. Define the material before buying “24/6”

Ginkgo requires a material identity, not merely a percentage. Dried leaf, powdered leaf, ordinary solvent leaf extract, selectively refined and quantified dry extract, seed kernels, sarcotesta and bark are different study materials. EMA treats powdered leaf and a specific dry extract separately, with different evidence bases; leaf-extract composition cannot be transferred to seeds or leaf tea.[28] An original market-quality investigation identified products whose composition was more consistent with leaf powder than the declared extract, demonstrating that correct botanical identity does not establish correct preparation identity.[2]

The European Pharmacopoeia version cited in a 2018 investigation described refined quantified extract with 22.0–27.0% flavone glycosides, 5.4–6.6% terpene lactones, comprising 2.8–3.4% ginkgolides A/B/C and 2.6–3.2% bilobalide, ginkgolic acids below 5 ppm, and a drug-to-extract ratio of 35–67:1.[2] These describe that preparation rather than every commercial ginkgo ingredient. “24/6” refers approximately to two compound groups, not the purity of two molecules.[2] A useful purchasing profile therefore includes pre- and post-hydrolysis flavonoids, individual lactones, ginkgolic-acid homologues, other constituents and excipients.

**Route A: publicly described pharmaceutical-style refining.** Dried leaves are extracted with acetone/water. After acetone removal, multiple selective operations reduce unwanted substances, including ginkgolic acids and biflavones, while enriching flavone glycosides and terpene lactones. The quality paper describes approximately 18 subsequent operations for a particular process, but does not provide a reproducible manufacturing recipe.[2] The important engineering lesson is that extraction yield, glycoside recovery, lactone recovery and acid removal are separate responses. Optimizing only dry-extract yield can reward recovery of sugars, salts and unwanted material.

**Route B: an institutionally documented ethanol/resin process.** A 2021 EFSA assessment of a feed-additive application records extended extraction of dried leaves in ethanol at 30°C, centrifugation, resin-column adsorption, ethanol elution, evaporation, spray drying, and subsequent maltodextrin addition, milling, sieving and packing.[4] Manufacturing scale, resin identity and a complete acid-removal validation were not disclosed. EFSA found characterization inadequate and did not establish safety for the proposed cat/dog feed use.[4] This source connects unit operations to material flows; it does not establish equivalence between an ethanol/resin product and a pharmacopoeial preparation.

**Engineering proposal: six measurable units.** (1) Receive and cut leaves while recording moisture, lot and particle-size distribution; assay representative composites. (2) Control actual solvent composition, liquid-to-solid ratio, temperature history and contact time; leaf moisture and recycled solvent change the true solvent concentration. (3) Measure clarification and retained liquor in centrifuge solids or filter cake. (4) Assay feed, breakthrough, washes and elution cuts for both desired groups and acids. (5) Compare dry-basis composition and solvent residues before and after concentration/drying. (6) Include carriers in the mass balance: the final marketed powder, not the carrier-free intermediate, must meet the intended label.

Potential failures to investigate include excessive fines and filter resistance, prolonged thermal exposure, resin overload, channeling, inadequate regeneration and overly broad pooling of elution fractions. Resin brand names cannot rule these out. Report target-compound mass recovery separately from acid removal. Recovery uses the incoming mass of that compound as its denominator; final concentration uses the total dry mass of the marketed powder, including carrier. A compositionally acceptable powder can still have poor recovery economics.

blocks.text: The magnetic-particle paper is particularly instructive. Fe3O4 particles in methanol captured acids from a petroleum-ether leaf extract, with approximately 4–5% w/w adsorption capacity. Acidified methanol produced a fraction containing 73% ginkgolic acids, followed by C8 preparative chromatography.[21] Here “purification” means concentrating the unwanted constituent as a useful reference/research substance, not lowering acids in a food ingredient to 5 ppm. The study supports an explanation of coordination selectivity, not a claim that ordinary commercial powder uses nanoparticle detoxification.

en.heading: Applications: turn chemical conformity into dosage-form performance

blocks.text: **Capsules and tablets—engineering proposals.** Fix the delivered mass of marketed powder per serving before screening loose/tapped density, size distribution and moisture uptake. Compare direct blending with granulation only after those properties are known. For low-dose material mixed with excipients of different particle size, use a premix and spatial sampling; average capsule weight does not demonstrate marker uniformity. If compaction changes disintegration or dissolution, track both the flavonoid and lactone groups rather than assuming the readily measured flavonoids represent all compounds. Uniformity and release are separate development questions.

**Liquids and combinations.** The EFSA applicant's extract was described as partially soluble in water and organic solvents.[4] The proposed development screen should therefore distinguish dispersion from dissolution using the intended pH, ionic strength, sweetener system and use concentration. Measure immediate turbidity, cold precipitation, heat-induced sediment and marker recovery before/after filtration. A clearer liquid may have lost a selective fraction of the original extract. An excipient/other-botanical blank helps identify contributions from unrelated flavonoids.

**Brand education.** Leaf identity, dual marker groups, low-level unwanted-constituent control and assay comparability are meaningful subjects. Removing ginkgolic acids is not direct evidence of improved efficacy. EMA distinguishes the use of a specific dry extract for age-associated cognitive impairment and quality of life in mild dementia from traditional-use conclusions for powdered leaf in minor circulatory symptoms.[28] Keeping the preparation and endpoint visible is more informative than a generic memory claim.

en.heading: Standards and analytical comparability

blocks.text: Pharmacopoeial-style flavonoid testing simplifies a complex glycoside mixture by hydrolysis, quantifying quercetin, kaempferol and isorhamnetin and applying a specified glycoside calculation. The 2018 investigation instead used three external standards and explicitly noted differences from the pharmacopoeial method and calculations.[2] Thus “HPLC” alone does not establish comparability: hydrolysis, standard identity, molecular-weight conversion, extraction and dry-basis calculation matter. Hydrolysis erases original glycosylation information, while added aglycones can increase the converted value. Pre-hydrolysis aglycones, the broader fingerprint and lactone composition address this blind spot.[2]

blocks.text: 0. 材料地图：籽提取物、籽油、皮提取物不是同一个故事

葡萄籽提取物应以籽来源的多酚与原花青素谱为主线，不应混入葡萄籽油的脂质指标、葡萄皮的色素故事或单独白藜芦醇的研究结果。针对临床研究供样的原始质量论文把葡萄籽提取物胶囊、白藜芦醇胶囊与康科德葡萄汁分开表征，并分别建立分析方法，说明同属“葡萄来源”不足以支持化学互换。[34] 采购材料名称应至少注明物种、植物部位、酿酒前后状态、是否先榨油、脱脂方式、提取溶剂以及载体。籽油与多酚提取物是不同分离目标，若先做油再提多酚，应把两条物流分别立项，不把油收率当作原花青素回收率。

原花青素是由黄烷-3-醇单元组成的低聚或高聚混合物，不是一个单一分子；“OPC”还需要声明低聚区间如何定义。[14][52] 2000年的原始方法比较把2–7聚体列为低聚部分，8–24以及更大的聚合物另列，并显示商业样品之间各区间差异很大。[52] 因而“95% OPC”若未注明方法、标准物和聚合度区间，信息量不如一张清晰的单体/低聚/高聚分布图。总多酚、可沉淀单宁与低聚原花青素不应在报价表中作为同一列比较。

**可复核的原始实验。** Thilakarathna与Rupasinghe的2022年研究用商业葡萄籽及籽粉，来源包含Vitis vinifera、V. labrusca及与美洲种相关的杂交商业品种。每次取1.0 g置50 mL管中；第二阶段固定47%乙醇，改变液固比、超声时间与温度，最终条件为10:1（mL/g）、53 min、60°C。[14] 原花青素通过甲基纤维素可沉淀单宁法、以儿茶素当量定量，而非对所有分子逐一称重；这些条件对应克级实验，不是工业提取罐的验证工艺。[14]

该研究先做常温摇动提取的响应面，得到约数日的时间需求，随后加入超声与加热以减少时间和溶剂量；论文报告优化水醇流程测得约25.3 mg儿茶素当量/g鲜重基准，所比较丙酮流程为约9.1 mg/g。[14] 重要的解释是：不同溶剂的比较同时带着该实验的液固比、温度、接触方式与测定法，不能抽象成“乙醇永远优于丙酮”。论文也讨论了其他研究中不同的溶剂排序。[14] 工程团队应把产量分为干浸膏质量、方法定义的原花青素当量、色谱可识别组分及特定聚合度部分四个响应。
**工程建议的连续流程。** 籽料分选与适度干燥 → 根据整籽/破碎籽试验决定粒度 → 水或水醇提取 → 离心/过滤 → 必要时吸附分级和水洗去糖 → 洗脱与溶剂回收 → 浓缩 → 干燥 → 均化与包装。提取液并非天然就高纯，水醇会同时带出非目标物；当产品任务是高多酚低糖粉，必须给去糖和富集单元预留物料衡算，不应由一个高颜色反应值来假定纯化完成。

**关键变量与失效机制。** 工程判断中，液固比增大可以降低溶液侧浓度，但增加蒸发负荷；温度与超声可促进传质，也可能改变组分分布。超细粉碎未必值得：上述研究在第一阶段没有发现籽粉相对整籽具有明显的原花青素得率优势，第二阶段只用了整籽。[14] 因此应先测粗破碎带来的回收增益是否超过过滤困难和设备负担。循环回用乙醇需同时测实际浓度、色度与可溶杂质，不能把“回收率高”视为无限次无损循环。精制柱的上样浓度、流速、床高和分段合并规则应以目标聚合度谱的流穿/洗脱变化决定，避免高聚物在某段富集后被当作低聚规格交付。
**计算建议。** 同时建立原料干物质衡算和标志物衡算：成品总干重应拆成提取物固形物、载体与其他辅料；标志物回收须以同一方法测试进料和各物流。以儿茶素当量得到的质量只能在该测定体系内做相对衡算，不是所有真实原花青素分子的绝对质量。真实经济指标是每公斤可交付目标谱粉末的原料、乙醇、水、热能和清洗成本，而不是每锅总浸膏重量。

zh.heading: 应用：涩感、浑浊、颜色和释放是四个不同问题

blocks.text: **饮料与蛋白系统。** 原花青素作为单宁类混合物，在食品中可带来涩味等功能特性，2022研究的背景明确讨论了食品应用。[14] 工程建议将蛋白结合/沉淀列为开发假设：在目标pH与离子强度下比较无蛋白基液、目标乳/植物蛋白液和实际复配体系，测即时及储存浊度、沉淀量、上清多酚与感官涩度。若总量留在瓶底而不是饮用液中，投料量并不等于均匀可消费的剂量。降低用量、调节加入顺序、先制稳定分散体或改变原料聚合度谱，均需用真实配方验证，不能仅凭水中溶解试验选择供应商。

**胶囊与片剂。** 已有原始研究把临床供样的葡萄籽胶囊质量均匀性、化学谱及溶出评价联系起来；其溶出方法描述使用USP装置2、100 rpm、900 mL介质，比较pH 1.2与4.6，追踪没食子酸、儿茶素、原花青素B2和表儿茶素。[34] 这是特定研究的测试设计，并非本文建议每款补充剂都套用同一接受限。它提供一个关键开发逻辑：胶囊总重量一致，不代表多酚谱一致；原粉检测合格，不代表成品释放一致。应在商品剂型中做标志物的提取回收和释放方法适用性试验。

**软糖与化妆品的工程建议。** 软糖应把酸度、加料温度、基胶类型和水活度作为共同变量；感官遮涩不能只靠增加糖，也要看颜色和凝胶结构是否改变。化妆品应比较配方pH、金属离子接触、乳化剂及防腐体系，跟踪色差、异味、离心稳定性和多酚谱；细胞抗氧化数据不能替代乳液储存和包装相容性。关于活性包装，只能在真实膜材上进一步测试机械性能、迁移、抗菌挑战与接触食品条件，本文没有以现有仓库的包装论文代替葡萄籽全应用证据。

合同建议把“原花青素”写成“按X方法，以Y标准物、Z干基/商品基准表达，并附指定区间指纹”，而不只写OPC≥某数值。每份实际递送量应以原料商品含量乘投料量再考虑成品回收，不把实验室去糖后的研究部分直接当作含麦芽糊精商品粉。当前药典、行业标准与目的市场法规的完整现行文本未全部取得，因此本文不给未经核验的法定统一规格。

en.heading: Process: solvent selectivity, mass transfer and refining all matter

blocks.text: 0. Material map: seed extract is not seed oil or skin extract

A grape-seed dossier should follow seed-derived polyphenols and proanthocyanidin profiles, not mix in seed-oil lipid specifications, skin pigment narratives or evidence for isolated resveratrol. An original clinical-supply quality study characterized grape-seed-extract capsules, resveratrol capsules and Concord grape juice separately, developing different analytical procedures.[34] A purchasing identity should specify species, part, fermentation history, whether oil was removed, defatting method, solvent and carrier. Oil and polyphenol recovery are distinct separation objectives and require separate mass balances.

Proanthocyanidins are heterogeneous oligomers/polymers of flavan-3-ol units rather than one molecule; “OPC” needs a declared oligomer-size definition.[14][52] A 2000 original comparison classified 2–7-unit material as oligomeric and larger groups separately, showing wide variation among commercial materials.[52] “95% OPC” without method, standard and size range is less informative than a clearly calibrated monomer/oligomer/polymer profile. Total polyphenols, precipitable tannins and oligomeric proanthocyanidins should not occupy an interchangeable quotation column.

**A reproducible laboratory example.** Thilakarathna and Rupasinghe used commercial seeds/seed powder derived from a mixture including Vitis vinifera, V. labrusca and hybrids involving native American species. Each extraction used 1.0 g in a 50 mL tube. Their second optimization fixed ethanol at 47% and varied liquid-to-solid ratio, ultrasound duration and temperature; the final settings were 10 mL/g, 53 minutes and 60°C.[14] Yield was measured using a methylcellulose-precipitable tannin assay expressed as catechin equivalents, not by weighing every individual PAC molecule. This is a gram-scale experiment, not a validated industrial-vessel process.[14]

The first response-surface exercise used ambient shaking and implied extraction over several days. Ultrasound and heating were then introduced to reduce time and solvent demand. The paper reports approximately 25.3 mg catechin equivalents/g fresh-weight basis for the optimized aqueous-ethanol route versus approximately 9.1 mg/g for its acetone comparison.[14] Solvent rankings therefore carry the study's temperature, ratio, contact conditions and assay. The authors discuss contrary rankings in other studies; the result is not proof that ethanol always outperforms acetone.[14] Separate four development responses: dry extract mass, method-defined PAC equivalents, identified chromatographic compounds and the targeted size fraction.

**Proposed engineering sequence.** Sort and condition seeds → determine particle size from intact/coarsely broken comparisons → extract in water or aqueous ethanol → centrifuge/filter → where required, adsorptive fractionation and sugar-removing wash → elute and recover solvent → concentrate → dry → homogenize and package. Crude extract is not automatically highly purified. A high-polyphenol/low-sugar target requires an explicit sugar-removal and enrichment balance; a strong color reaction does not establish purification.

Increasing liquid-to-solid ratio can reduce solution-side concentration but increases downstream evaporation duty. Heat and ultrasound can improve release while changing the recovered distribution. Finer milling is not automatically beneficial: the 2022 study found no large PAC-yield advantage for powder in its first stage and used intact seeds in its second stage.[14] Test whether coarse breakage provides enough recovery improvement to offset clarification costs. Recycled ethanol needs concentration, color and impurity tracking. Adsorption feed strength, flow, bed height and pooling should be selected using breakthrough/elution profiles of the desired size groups, rather than delivering a polymer-enriched fraction under an oligomer specification.

Mass-balance proposals should distinguish extract solids, carrier and other excipients. PAC equivalents support comparisons within the same assay but are not the absolute mass of all PAC molecules. The economic output is feedstock, ethanol, water, heat and cleaning per kilogram of deliverable target-profile powder, not kilograms of total crude solids per vessel.

en.heading: Applications: astringency, haze, color and release are separate

blocks.text: **Beverages/protein systems.** The 2022 paper discusses PACs as tannin-type food ingredients with properties including astringency.[14] Treat protein binding/precipitation as a development hypothesis: compare protein-free base, target dairy/plant protein and the final formulation at intended pH and ionic strength. Measure immediate/stored turbidity, sediment, supernatant polyphenols and sensory astringency. Material at the bottom of the bottle does not provide a uniform consumed dose. Lower loading, altered addition sequence, a stabilized dispersion or a different size profile are options to test, not automatic remedies established by a water-solubility demonstration.

**Capsules/tablets.** An original clinical-supply study connected capsule uniformity, composition and dissolution. Its described dissolution design used USP apparatus 2, 100 rpm, 900 mL medium and pH 1.2 versus 4.6, following gallic acid, catechin, procyanidin B2 and epicatechin.[34] These are study-specific conditions, not universal supplement acceptance criteria. The useful logic is that equal capsule mass does not establish equal polyphenol profiles, and acceptable raw powder does not establish finished-product release. Validate marker extraction and release in the marketed dosage form.

**Gummies/cosmetics—engineering proposals.** In gummies, jointly evaluate acidity, addition temperature, gel system and water activity. More sugar is not the sole route to reducing perceived astringency, and may change texture/color. For cosmetics, screen pH, metal contact, emulsifier and preservative systems with color, odor, centrifuge stability and chromatographic measurements. Cellular antioxidant activity cannot replace emulsion storage or package-compatibility tests. Active-packaging development additionally requires actual film mechanical properties, migration, challenge testing and food-contact conditions; the repository's existing packaging theme is not used as evidence for every grape-seed application.

en.heading: Standards and assay comparability

blocks.text: The original method comparison found that colorimetric assays provide only crude size-distribution information, whereas normal-phase HPLC separates monomer, oligomer and larger-polymer regions.[52] A separate HPLC/UV/MS investigation compared 21 commercial products with authenticated grape seed, peanut skin and pine bark extracts, identified peanut-skin adulteration in nine, and developed TLC screening.[33] Nine of 21 describes that sample set, not today's market prevalence. It establishes why total phenolics and antioxidant capacity cannot authenticate botanical source.

blocks.text: A proposed QA hierarchy combines incoming botanical/process identity, complementary total-content and fingerprint/size methods, physical powder performance, and finished-product uniformity/release. Full structural research need not occur on every release lot, but representative lots should first connect structure, assay and application. Reassess after changes to source, defatting, resin or carrier. Residual-solvent panels should follow the real process, and non-detects require a quantification limit.

A usable specification reads “PAC by method X, against standard Y, on basis Z, with the defined profile attached,” rather than merely OPC above a number. Delivered content uses the marketed powder's assay and formulation recovery, not the researcher's sugar-free fraction. Complete current pharmacopoeial/industry texts and destination-market legal requirements were not all obtained; no unverified universal legal specification is asserted.

zh.heading: 工艺维：两条路线必须从第一步就区分

blocks.text: 0. 从身份分流：不是所有红色粉末都是“枸杞多糖”

枸杞全果粉、果汁粉、粗水提物、脱去游离糖的多糖富集物、进一步按分子量分级的多糖以及类胡萝卜素导向材料，应各建一张身份卡。全果粉保留的组织颗粒与果汁粉的可溶固形物不同；多糖纯化则主动改变果实原有糖、蛋白、多酚和色素的比例。原始多糖研究用乙醇分级和超滤得到三个分子量不同的组分，发现即使总糖接近，单糖组成、蛋白和多酚仍有差异，生物学表现也不相同。[37] 因而“来自枸杞”和“总糖很高”均不足以说明它是哪一种多糖。
关于果实组成的综述把多糖、甜菜碱、类胡萝卜素等作为不同化学家族讨论，并记录不同深加工路径。[9] 研发应按用途选材料：以果味、颜色和复溶为主时研究果汁粉；以某一多糖组分的结构与一致性为主时研究富集/分级材料；以玉米黄质递送为主时建立单独的色素测定与稳定性方案。叶多糖研究不得自动并入果多糖资料；文献里的植物部位是一个实质工艺变量，而非背景注释。

**路线A，果汁粉的工程方案。** 原果分选与清洗 → 打浆/榨汁 → 按清汁或浑浊汁定位选择粗筛、离心或澄清 → 经独立验证的微生物控制步骤 → 必要时低热负荷浓缩 → 载体混合与均质 → 干燥 → 防潮包装。它的目标是保持可接受的风味、颜色、复溶与储存性能，而不是最大限度去掉果实的天然糖。每个澄清步骤都可能改变悬浮组织及其所携带组分，建议把清汁与浑浊汁明确写进材料名。本文未取得可核实的枸杞果汁喷干原始工艺全文，因此不提供冒充枸杞实测的进风温度、载体最佳比例或粉末收率。

糖与有机酸丰富食品的单液滴干燥原始研究，使用果糖、葡萄糖、蔗糖与柠檬酸及其麦芽糊精混合物，结合热质传递模型研究黏性和干燥动力学。[20] 这是模型体系，不是枸杞果汁试验。工程推论是：果汁粉载体应作为粉体玻璃态、黏壁与水分响应的设计变量，而非只用于“稀释活性”。开发时可测吸湿曲线、玻璃化行为、粉末回收率和复溶，再用实际枸杞汁筛选载体含量；载体增加改善可加工性的同时会降低每克商品粉的果实固形物比例，这个算术关系应进入标签与成本核算。

**路线B，粗多糖—分级多糖的真实实验。** 一项2023原始研究采用宁夏中宁采购并鉴别的枸杞，纯水提取两次，离心收集上清并浓缩；先加95%乙醇使体系达到50%乙醇，过夜后去掉沉淀，再把上清调到85%乙醇，放置12小时后收集沉淀，重新溶解、Sevag法去蛋白、浓缩冻干，获得粗多糖。[37] 这里50%阶段去掉沉淀、85%阶段收集沉淀，流向不能写反；“加85%乙醇”也不同于“终浓度85%”。该工艺服务于研究级样品制备，不能把分析级溶剂与去蛋白操作直接默认成食用大生产流程。

同研究将10 g粗多糖溶于60 mL水，先用1 kDa超滤管去掉单糖和部分低聚糖，再经3 kDa与10 kDa超滤管分出1–3、3–10和>10 kDa部分，冻干得到LBPs-1、LBPs-2、LBPs-3。[37] 这明确是克级粗多糖及超滤管分离，不是工业膜站。随后用HPSEC-RID-MALLS测得三个部分的绝对分子量约1.912、7.481和46.239 kDa；膜标称区间和实测分子量是不同信息，前者不能替代后者。[37]

**路线C，超声强化释放的实验依据。** 多模式超声原始研究在20 g/600 mL、60°C、30 min条件下比较设备模式，固定声功率密度300 W/L及脉冲方式；单频28 kHz条件报告粗多糖得率26.38%，能量聚集逆流双频20/40 kHz报告38.93%。[39] 这些是该方法定义的“粗多糖得率”，不能当作果实含有38.93%的纯结构多糖。由于研究目标和分离方式不同，不应拿它与另一研究的高纯组分得率直接排名。对工程团队的价值是说明声场、频率组合、循环与冷却控制有研究意义，而不是给吨级提取机一个可复制产能数字。

blocks.text: **工程建议：超滤不是自动“净化到一种多糖”。** 膜截留取决于分子的水动力尺寸、形状及膜相互作用；所以将相同标称截留量的膜换材质后，应重新测透过液/截留液的糖谱、分子量分布与质量回收。以清水通量判断运行稳定会遗漏真实多糖料液的黏度和污染；试验应记录单位膜面积通量随浓缩倍数的衰减，再决定膜面积和清洗周期。用恒容透析过滤去游离糖时，应监测糖排出而不是只记录加入了多少桶水。
**乙醇和热量的工程账。** 沉淀前过度稀释会显著增加乙醇用量与回收负荷，浓缩过头又会使混合困难；可先用黏度—浓度曲线找可操作窗口。残余蛋白并不总是单纯杂质，某些研究部分含蛋白/多酚结合组分，因此采用更强去蛋白或脱色步骤时要比较目标谱是否改变。[37] 工艺变更的评价不应只写“纯度提升”，而要交代去掉了什么、保留了什么、性能如何变化。

zh.heading: 应用维：甜味体系与结构组分有不同的实际难题

blocks.text: **果汁饮料和冲调粉。** 工程建议以商品粉而非实验室去糖部分做复溶：固定投料浓度、水温与搅拌能量，记录润湿时间、团聚、上清透光、沉淀和色泽。全果粉的不溶纤维不应被误判为果汁粉质量缺陷；反过来，标签称澄清果汁粉却有大量沉积，则应追查原料定义和工艺。糖和载体贡献都进入可溶固形物，但二者对品牌可声明的果实含量意义不同，应分别核算。
**软糖。** 工程建议先做果汁粉与多糖富集物两个独立系列，保持总可溶固形物或含水量可比，再比较凝胶强度、黏附性、颜色、水活度与储存变化。果汁粉带来的糖会改变配方固形物平衡；多糖部分可能改变黏度与凝胶网络，因此相同添加百分数不构成功能等量。用“后添加以保护活性”作为口号不够，必须把加料时温度、停留时间、混合均匀性与微生物控制一起验证。
**多糖结构研究与高值产品。** 对黏度或研究级组分递送，应测特定浓度下流变、盐/pH响应、冻融及加热后分子量谱。去糖、脱蛋白、超声及热处理都可能改变最终材料的相对组成；原始分级研究显示不同部分在ORAC、ABTS与斑马鱼免疫模型中并非相同排序，不能以一个抗氧化数字解释所有应用。[37] 实际开发应选择与产品任务相关的性能响应，例如易分散、低黏度或指定谱保留，而不是盲目追求更高分子量。

**类胡萝卜素与“护眼”内容。** 枸杞整果的人体试验与纯化多糖的细胞试验应分两栏。27名45–65岁参与者的随机、未设盲平行试点研究，以28 g枸杞每周五次、90天，与含6 mg叶黄素和4 mg玉米黄质的补充剂比较，观察黄斑色素光密度等指标。[43] 这不是低剂量果汁粉或去色素多糖胶囊的试验，也不是疾病发生率研究。原料内容可具体解释果实色素与水溶多糖是两条不同研究路径，避免把“红色水果”“多糖含量”与眼部临床结论合成一个未经证明的因果链。

zh.heading: 标准与方法维：总糖结果不是身份鉴定

blocks.text: 2023原始分级研究用苯酚—硫酸法、葡萄糖作标准测总糖，并另测蛋白、多酚，使用HPAEC-PAD测单糖组成、HPSEC-RID-MALLS测分子量、FTIR及NMR等研究结构。[37] 这个方法组合本身就是重要知识：总糖含量只是化学账的一部分，必须结合“小糖是否去除”“是否含载体”“分子量是什么”“单糖组成如何”才适合描述多糖材料。未经预处理的果汁粉含量若直接以显色法称“枸杞多糖”，有把游离糖与麦芽糊精计入响应的风险，需对具体方法做加标和分离验证。

en.heading: Process: two routes separate from the start

blocks.text: 0. Split identities before discussing percentages

Whole-fruit powder, juice powder, crude aqueous extract, free-sugar-depleted polysaccharide concentrate, molecular-weight fractions and carotenoid-oriented ingredients require separate identity records. Whole-fruit tissue particles differ from juice solids, and polysaccharide refining intentionally changes sugar, protein, phenolic and pigment proportions. An original fractionation study obtained three size fractions with differences in monosaccharides, proteins, polyphenols and biological responses even where total sugars were similar.[37] Fruit origin and high total sugar therefore do not identify a particular polysaccharide.

A processing review treats polysaccharides, betaine and carotenoids as separate chemical families and discusses distinct processing routes.[9] Choose material according to the application: juice powder for fruit flavor/color/reconstitution, enriched/fractionated material for polysaccharide consistency, and a separate pigment-assay/stability program for zeaxanthin delivery. Leaf-polysaccharide papers cannot automatically support fruit-polysaccharide specifications; plant part is a material process variable.

**Route A—proposed juice-powder engineering.** Sort/wash fruit → pulp or press → choose coarse screening, centrifugation or clarification for the intended clear/cloudy juice → independently validated microbial control → optional low-thermal-load concentration → carrier mixing/homogenization → drying → moisture-protective packaging. The objective is acceptable flavor, color, reconstitution and storage, not removal of all native fruit sugars. Clarification can alter the suspended tissue and its associated constituents, so clear versus cloudy juice should appear in the identity. A verifiable original goji-juice spray-drying process paper was not obtained; no claimed goji-specific optimum inlet temperature, carrier loading or powder yield is supplied.

An original single-droplet engineering study used fructose, glucose, sucrose and citric acid, individually and with maltodextrin, alongside heat/mass-transfer modelling to investigate drying and stickiness.[20] This is a model system, not goji juice. The engineering inference is to treat carrier level as a powder-state, adhesion and moisture-response variable, not merely an active-ingredient diluent. Screen sorption, glass-transition behavior, recovery and reconstitution in actual juice. More carrier simultaneously reduces fruit solids per gram of marketed powder; that mass-balance relationship belongs in costing and labeling.

**Route B—an actual crude-polysaccharide/fractionation experiment.** A 2023 original study used authenticated berries purchased in Zhongning, Ningxia. Fruit was extracted twice with purified water, supernatants were collected by centrifugation and concentrated. Adding 95% ethanol to a final 50% ethanol concentration followed by overnight holding produced a precipitate that was discarded. The remaining liquid was adjusted to 85% ethanol; after 12 hours the precipitate was collected, redissolved, deproteinized by the Sevag method, concentrated and freeze-dried.[37] The discarded and retained streams must not be reversed, and adding an 85% ethanol solution is not the same as reaching 85% final ethanol. Analytical-grade solvents/deproteinization are research preparation details, not automatically food-production operations.

The researchers dissolved 10 g crude polysaccharides in 60 mL water. A 1 kDa ultrafiltration tube removed monosaccharides/some oligosaccharides; 3 and 10 kDa tubes then produced 1–3, 3–10 and >10 kDa fractions, which were freeze-dried as LBPs-1/2/3.[37] This is a gram-scale tube separation, not an industrial membrane plant. HPSEC-RID-MALLS subsequently measured approximately 1.912, 7.481 and 46.239 kDa. Nominal membrane cutoffs and measured molecular weights are distinct outputs.[37]

**Route C—ultrasound-assisted release.** An original multimode-ultrasound study compared modes at 20 g/600 mL, 60°C and 30 minutes, with 300 W/L and controlled pulsing. It reported 26.38% crude-polysaccharide yield for 28 kHz single-frequency operation and 38.93% for energy-aggregation counterflow dual-frequency operation at 20/40 kHz.[39] These are the study's crude-yield results, not proof that fruit contains 38.93% purified structural polysaccharide. Different isolation/assay endpoints prevent direct ranking against purified-fraction yields. The engineering value concerns field geometry, frequency, circulation and cooling, not a transferable industrial capacity figure.

blocks.text: **Engineering proposals.** Ultrafiltration does not automatically purify one polysaccharide. Retention depends on hydrodynamic size, shape and membrane interactions; changing membrane chemistry at the same nominal cutoff requires renewed permeate/retentate sugar profiles, molecular-weight distributions and recoveries. Water flux does not establish performance with viscous polysaccharide feed. Record flux per membrane area against concentration factor before sizing membrane area and cleaning cycles. During constant-volume diafiltration, track free-sugar removal rather than only wash-water input.

Excessive dilution before precipitation increases ethanol and recovery duty, while excessive concentration impairs mixing; use a viscosity/concentration curve to find an operating window. Residual protein is not always simply irrelevant impurity: some studied fractions contain protein/phenolic-associated components. Stronger deproteinization or decolorization should therefore be assessed for changes to the intended material profile.[37] Report what was removed, retained and changed in performance, rather than merely claiming improved purity.

en.heading: Applications: fruit solids and structural fractions behave differently

blocks.text: **Beverages/instant powders—proposals.** Test the marketed powder, not a laboratory sugar-free fraction, at fixed loading, water temperature and mixing energy. Record wetting, lumping, clarity, sediment and color. Insoluble fiber in whole-fruit powder is not automatically a juice-powder defect; substantial sediment in a declared clear-juice powder, however, calls for an identity/process investigation. Both fruit sugars and carriers contribute soluble solids, but have different implications for declared fruit content and should be calculated separately.

**Gummies—proposals.** Run separate juice-powder and polysaccharide-concentrate series with comparable total soluble solids or water content before comparing gel strength, tack, color, water activity and storage changes. Juice sugars alter solids balance, while polymer fractions may change viscosity and gel structure. Equal ingredient percentages are not functional equivalence. “Late addition protects activity” is insufficient without validating addition temperature, holding time, mixing uniformity and microbial control.

**Higher-value polysaccharide products.** For rheological or research-fraction applications, test concentration-dependent flow, salt/pH response, freeze/thaw and post-heating molecular-weight profiles. Sugar removal, deproteinization, ultrasound and heat can change the mixture. The original fractionation study found that different fractions did not rank identically across ORAC, ABTS and zebrafish immune models.[37] Choose the response relevant to the product—such as dispersibility, low viscosity or profile retention—instead of automatically maximizing molecular weight.

**Carotenoids and eye-health education.** Whole-fruit human studies and isolated-polysaccharide cell studies belong in separate evidence columns. A randomized, unmasked pilot involved 27 adults aged 45–65 consuming 28 g berries five times weekly for 90 days, compared with a supplement containing 6 mg lutein and 4 mg zeaxanthin; endpoints included macular pigment optical density.[43] It did not test low-dose juice powder, depigmented polysaccharide capsules or disease incidence. Explain fruit pigments and water-soluble polysaccharides as distinct research paths rather than joining red color, polysaccharide percentage and clinical eye outcomes into an unsupported causal chain.

en.heading: Standards and analytical methods

blocks.text: The original fractionation paper measured total sugars by phenol–sulfuric acid with glucose calibration, separately measured protein/polyphenols, and used HPAEC-PAD for monosaccharide composition, HPSEC-RID-MALLS for molecular weight, and FTIR/NMR for structure.[37] That combination is itself instructive: total sugar is only one entry in the chemical balance. Free-sugar removal, carriers, size distribution and building-block composition are needed to describe a polysaccharide material. Direct colorimetry of untreated juice powder risks counting free sugars and maltodextrin; this requires specific separation/spike validation rather than assuming the assay is selective.

zh.heading: 工艺：甘草酸、DGL、光甘草定是三种不同的产品任务

blocks.text: 甘草不能只用“10:1提取物”定义。甘草酸又称 glycyrrhizin/glycyrrhizic acid，是与甘草风险评估相关的重要组分；DGL 是降低甘草酸后的混合制备物；光甘草定 glabridin 则是光果甘草 Glycyrrhiza glabra 的异黄烷标志物，不能把其含量等同于总黄酮，也不能把乌拉尔甘草或胀果甘草自动当作同等原料。[4][44][48] 因此，研发立项第一张图应是目标物和去除物的物料去向图，而不是设备照片。

blocks.text: 这一区分有实际实验依据：Fu 等在2005年比较 XDA-1、LSA-10、D101、LSA-20 四种大孔树脂，用粗甘草提取液分离甘草黄酮与甘草酸。所读论文摘要报告 XDA-1 对两类组分有较高容量，同时对黄酮的亲和力更强；一次柱操作取得约21.9%黄酮富集物和66%甘草酸富集物。[4] 这是该研究的分离结果，不是“DGL统一含量标准”。摘要使用“free of GA”，但此次可访问正文片段未提供该表述对应的定量限，所以商业放行应使用经过验证的残留数值，不能写“完全不含”。[4]

**DGL 开发步骤及物料变化。**工程建议是把已澄清粗提液作为柱分离进料，首先同时测甘草酸和目标黄酮，再比较不同进料 pH 下的动态穿透与洗脱曲线。上述研究观察到降低 pH 会提高甘草酸和黄酮的吸附容量，因此“吸得更多”并不意味着“选择性更好”；工艺必须找到能分开两类组分的切段窗口。[4] 收集进料流出液、洗涤液、各洗脱段和再生液，用各段体积乘含量做质量平衡。富集段浓缩干燥后再测残留和黄酮指纹，以识别柱后混批、夹带或辅料加入导致的变化。这里的操作顺序是开发框架，pH、床体积流速和乙醇梯度没有足够公开完整方法支持，故不填假设的“行业标准参数”。

**光甘草定路线不能沿用甘草酸路线。**Simmler 等综述指出光甘草定为光果甘草的物种相关标志物，文献所述根部干重含量为0.08%—0.35%，并与根的组织分布、产地和环境有关；该范围是文献材料观察，不是任一批原料的验收保证。[48] 其路线通常从合适溶剂提取和液液分配开始，再以吸附富集、制备色谱或结晶实现进一步分离。综述汇集的早期单体分离常需三到四个色谱/分配步骤，有些使用苯、氯仿等溶剂；这些是历史研究方法，不应作为食品或化妆品量产溶剂推荐。[48] 更实际的开发目标是用可接受的溶剂体系完成选择性分配和富集，并证明置换后选择性、杂质谱和回收率没有恶化。
光甘草定纯化中，“倍数增加”和“总回收”必须一起看。该综述转述 HPD100 树脂研究的富集倍数约150倍、回收约80%，提示高倍富集仍伴随目标物损失；分子印迹聚合物研究的回收仅42%—56%，洗涤段也发现光甘草定。[48] 这些数值来自综述所汇集的实验，当前不是独立复核的吨级运行结果，也不能据此选定本公司的树脂。采购若只问成品纯度，会漏掉影响真实成本的每批目标物损失。

blocks.text: 表中为工程选型建议；分离选择性和固相损失的依据分别来自树脂研究与光甘草定综述，配制风险来自2025年的实际溶解研究。[4][48][21] 对乙醇系统还应把回收、通风、防爆设计与清洗排放纳入设备边界，不把“绿色提取”简化成一种溶剂名称。树脂床径和高度应由允许压降、动态容量、目标处理量和再生周期联合确定；本次证据没有支撑某个固定床高或设备品牌最佳。

**可核查的失败案例。**2025年光甘草定研究以 DMSO 母液稀释进 PBS 后，观察到立即浑浊和针状晶体，晶体数量与尺寸随时间变化，随后沉降。[21] 研究者认为这既降低可供细胞接触的溶解组分，也可能引入物理损伤，因此不能把所有细胞毒性都解释为分子本身的固有作用。[21] 其方法以20 mg/mL母液稀释至100 μg/mL，并在室温观察至120分钟，过滤后用 HPLC 测上清；材料是实验室光甘草定和PBS，不是量产化妆品，所读段落未列整个配制批量。[21] 这一案例支持设备验证增加显微镜和上清定量，而非直接复制其包合比例；原文另有配比与真空单位的可疑写法，本稿不将其转录为操作处方。

zh.heading: 应用：把风味、口服固体和外用递送分开开发

blocks.text: 普通甘草根制备物已有食品调味和补充剂应用背景，而光甘草定文献包含独立的化妆品递送研究。[44][48] 对品牌而言，这意味着“甘草”一个词不能跨项目替代成分名称、组分组成和工艺来源。口服 DGL 应把残留甘草酸、目标黄酮指纹、每日实际投料量和其他甘草来源合并进入配方档案；风味项目还应记录苦味、甘草样后味、色泽和溶解行为，而不是只比较每公斤价格。

对光甘草定外用项目，工程建议先建立配方稀释路径：原料→预溶液→乳化相→成品→使用稀释。每个状态同时检测总含量、过滤上清含量和显微形态，避免“总含量未变”掩盖活性分子已析出。环糊精包合、纳米乳或多孔载体属于不同配制物，应披露载体质量分数与负载率；载体加入会改变每克成品中的光甘草定，而不只是改变宣传名称。光甘草定综述讨论了上述包埋路线及稳定性问题，2025年论文进一步展示溶剂置换对实验结果的影响。[48][21]
实际打样可设置同一光甘草定投料量的未配制粉、预溶液和候选载体组，另设载体空白组；在最终包装中对比避光、受光和温度应力。评价顺序为物理稳定→化学保持→皮肤适用性和宣称试验，而不是先按细胞文献选择营销功效。此处是试验设计建议；文献中的细胞、动物及不同载体结果并不提供本品牌成品的功效证据。[21][48]

zh.heading: 检测与标准：用双指标代替一个“提取比”

blocks.text: DGL 的证书应至少把甘草酸残留与保留组分拆成两项：第一项回答降低了多少，第二项回答留下了什么。工程建议统一干基/原样基、游离酸/盐型换算、标准品纯度校正和含辅料状态；方法应给出专属性、回收率和定量限，并证明对该混合提取物适用。对光甘草定，HPLC/UPLC 定量应配合光果甘草身份与指纹；如用于高纯单体研发，可用质谱、核磁或适宜正交方法进一步确认，不能只靠一个保留时间。综述明确指出许多早期研究只以 HPLC-UV 描述纯度，实际生物试验所用材料的完整纯度披露并不充分。[48]
质量放行另需结合实际溶剂历史确定残留溶剂项目，并按原料产地及用途核查农残、元素杂质和微生物。对经过柱处理的产品，树脂可浸出物、再生剂夹带和共线清洗是工艺审查点；这些是本稿给 QA 的风险化选项，而不是声称每一项都有统一全球限量。

甘草酸风险不是可以省略的商业细节：NIH LiverTox 对甘草高剂量不良反应给出明确描述，包括盐皮质激素样影响及高血压、低钾等背景。[44] 最有效的边界不是反复写“咨询专业人士”，而是规定残留方法、每日份量、叠加来源和目标人群审查的责任人。此次取得的 EMA 2010版甘草根专论 PDF 已标注 **Superseded**，仅作为传统草药制备物历史资料，不用于当前剂量或准入判断。[28] 食品、补充剂与化妆品的用途身份要分别审查；本文未完成中国、欧盟、美国所有相关现行条文逐项比对。

zh.heading: 科研意义与跨角色交接

blocks.text: 甘草研究的价值不仅是列举活性通路，而是解释“组分分离如何改变可研究材料”。DGL 分离能够把甘草酸相关效应和其他组分效应在设计上拆开；光甘草定的物种标志作用帮助把植物身份和定量化学连起来；析晶案例则说明细胞实验中的名义浓度不等于实际溶解浓度。[4][48][21] 研究计划应同时保留原始混合物、甘草酸富集段、DGL段与单体/载体对照，减少把复杂混合物结果归因于单一成分的错误。

en.heading: Process: choose the fraction before choosing the process

blocks.text: Licorice is not adequately defined by an extract ratio. Glycyrrhizin/glycyrrhizic acid, a deglycyrrhizinated mixed extract (DGL), and glabridin are different material targets. Glabridin is a species-associated isoflavan marker of Glycyrrhiza glabra; total flavonoids, DGL and glabridin cannot be used as interchangeable specifications.[4][44][48]

blocks.text: Fu et al. compared XDA-1, LSA-10, D101 and LSA-20 resins. Their accessible abstract reports higher adsorption capacity of XDA-1 for both constituent classes and greater affinity for licorice flavonoids. One column separation produced a flavonoid-rich fraction of approximately 21.9% purity and a glycyrrhizic-acid-rich fraction of 66% purity.[4] These are study results, not universal DGL specifications. The abstract says “free of GA”; its corresponding quantitation limit was not available in the retrieved excerpt, so a commercial specification needs a validated numerical residual limit.[4]

The proposed DGL development sequence is clarification, dual-marker feed assay, pH-dependent dynamic loading studies, fraction collection, mass balance, concentration and drying, followed by repeat residual and fingerprint testing. The study found increasing adsorption of both constituent classes as pH decreased: higher capacity alone therefore does not establish better separation.[4] Record target mass in feed, breakthrough, washes, eluates and regeneration streams. No universal pH, bed-volume rate or ethanol gradient is supplied because the complete column method was not retrieved.

The glabridin route starts with a different botanical and chemical target. Simmler et al. report literature concentrations of 0.08–0.35% of root dry weight, together with tissue localization and geographical/environmental variation; these are observations, not incoming-lot guarantees.[48] Extraction, liquid–liquid partition, adsorption, preparative chromatography and/or crystallization are candidate operations. Historical isolation methods often needed three or four chromatographic/partition stages and sometimes used benzene or chloroform; these solvents are not recommended here for commercial food or cosmetic production.[48] Replacement solvent systems require demonstrated selectivity and impurity control, not merely an acceptable solvent name.

The review reports approximately 150-fold enrichment and 80% glabridin recovery with HPD100, while molecularly imprinted polymer methods recovered only 42–56%, with glabridin also appearing in wash fractions.[48] These secondary-reported laboratory results illustrate why enrichment factor and total recovery must be evaluated together. They are not independently verified production-scale capacities.

blocks.text: These are engineering recommendations grounded in the adsorption, isolation and formulation literature.[4][48][21] Ethanol recovery, ventilation, explosion protection, cleaning and waste handling belong in the equipment scope. Bed geometry should follow dynamic capacity, flow demand, pressure drop and regeneration—not a generic “DGL machine” label.

A documented 2025 failure case is particularly useful: glabridin dissolved in DMSO became turbid and formed needle-like crystals when diluted into PBS; crystals increased and sedimented over time.[21] The laboratory method diluted a 20 mg/mL stock to 100 μg/mL and followed room-temperature samples for up to 120 minutes with filtered-supernatant HPLC. Total preparation batch volume was not given in the passage examined.[21] The authors associated precipitation with reduced dissolved exposure and possible physical cellular injury. This justifies microscopy and soluble-fraction measurement during validation, not copying an encapsulation recipe. Apparent ratio/vacuum-unit problems elsewhere in that paper were not reproduced as manufacturing instructions.

en.heading: Applications: flavor, oral solids and topical delivery are separate briefs

blocks.text: Licorice root preparations have flavoring and supplement use histories; glabridin literature separately examines topical delivery.[44][48] A DGL formula dossier should combine residual glycyrrhizic acid, retained-marker fingerprint, actual daily ingredient mass and other licorice sources. Flavor screening should also record color, bitterness, licorice-like aftertaste and dissolution rather than compare price per kilogram alone.

For topical glabridin, the proposed test chain is raw material → premix → emulsion phase → finished product → use dilution. At each stage, compare total assay, filtered-supernatant assay and microscopy. An unchanged total assay can conceal precipitation. Cyclodextrin complexes, nanoemulsions and porous carriers are different formulated materials; carrier percentage and loading determine glabridin per gram of the supplied powder.[48][21]

Compare unformulated powder, a premix and candidate carriers at matched glabridin dose, including carrier blanks. Test final packaging under dark, light and thermal conditions. Physical stability and chemical retention should precede skin suitability and finished-product claim studies. Cell and animal findings on different materials do not establish a brand’s clinical or cosmetic performance.[21][48]

en.heading: Testing and standards: two specifications instead of one ratio

blocks.text: A DGL certificate should answer both “how much glycyrrhizic acid remains?” and “what was retained?” The proposed method package aligns dry/as-is basis, acid/salt conversion, reference-standard correction and excipient status, and establishes specificity, recovery and quantitation limit. Glabridin assay should be accompanied by botanical identity and fingerprint information; purified research compounds may require orthogonal MS/NMR confirmation. The review highlights incomplete purity reporting and overreliance on HPLC-UV in earlier studies.[48]

Solvent history determines residual-solvent tests; origin and intended use inform pesticide, elemental and microbiological controls. Resin extractables, regeneration-agent carryover and shared-line cleaning are risk-based QA review topics, not claimed globally uniform limits.

NIH LiverTox describes serious high-dose licorice effects, including mineralocorticoid-like consequences and the context of hypertension and hypokalemia.[44] Operational safeguards are a residual method, serving calculation, combined-source review and defined population assessment. The retrieved EMA 2010 monograph is explicitly marked **Superseded** and is retained only as historical information, not a current dosing or market-entry authority.[28] Food, supplement and cosmetic regulatory identities require separate reviews; this dossier is not an exhaustive current China/EU/US legal crosswalk.

en.heading: Research significance and handover

blocks.text: DGL fractionation can help distinguish glycyrrhizic-acid-associated effects from other constituents; glabridin connects botanical identity with marker chemistry; the precipitation experiment shows why nominal cell-culture concentration can differ from dissolved exposure.[4][48][21] A useful study retains original extract, glycyrrhizic-acid-rich fraction, DGL fraction, isolated compound and carrier controls.

blocks.text: 甜菊糖苷是共享甜菊醇骨架、连接糖基不同的一组化合物。总糖苷含量回答精制程度，Reb A、D、M等单体比例回答组成；生产路线则回答骨架和糖基从哪里来，这三个问题应分别出现在原料说明中。[7][8] FSANZ A1268审批报告引用JECFA框架，明确列出叶片提取、微生物发酵、主要糖苷转为次要糖苷的酶转化，以及进一步添加葡萄糖单元的酶糖基化四种路径。[8]

blocks.text: 四类定义来自审批报告，不是营销分类。[8] 尤其要避免“酶由发酵制得，所以糖苷是发酵产品”的逻辑跳跃：生产加工酶的菌株，与以糖为碳源直接生产糖苷的菌株，属于不同物料路径。干燥改变水分和物态，不会凭空把Reb A变成Reb M；在多步结晶、母液回收、复配过程中单体比例变化，也不能误称为发生了生物转化。[7][8]

**叶提路线的实际工程问题。**2024年综述讨论热水/溶剂、超声等提取及后续纯化方法，但“提取率高”不等于获得合格甜味剂：叶片粗液同时带来需要去除的颜色、盐和其他成分。[34] 因此工程建议按叶片鉴别与含水→粗碎与浸出→固液分离→脱色/脱盐/糖苷富集→分级结晶→干燥与复配布置取样。浸出段测糖苷进入液相的质量，纯化段同时测色度、灰分或电导与糖苷损失，结晶段分别测晶体和母液的单体比例。这样可以区别“减少杂质使含量上升”和“回收更多糖苷”。
2025年超声结合树脂论文摘要给出20%乙醇、50°C、料液比1:10等优化条件，并报告研究中的得率指标变化。[36] 本次可读内容未充分显示其投料批量和得率分母定义，故不把该百分比转写成“每公斤叶片产出多少糖苷”，也不将上述条件用于设备报价。它的实际启示是提取、脱色、去杂和脱盐需要串联优化，不能只优化超声段后宣称全流程节能。[36]

**定向转化路线的具体实例。**A1268是Manus Bio申请、FSANZ于2023年批准的酶加工助剂评估，涉及工程大肠杆菌K-12生产的UTP-葡萄糖-1-磷酸尿苷酰转移酶、UDP-葡糖基转移酶与蔗糖合成酶。报告指出三个酶共同用于申请人的Reb M生产，而其Reb I生产使用其中两个酶。[8] 这表明酶系统不仅要有“加糖”的催化步骤，还涉及糖基供体相关反应；采购不能只要求一张“酶法Reb M”证书。工艺开发应追踪底物、各中间糖苷、目标物、糖类副产物以及残余蛋白，而不只测终点总糖苷。

**发酵路线的公开工艺实例。**Avansya于2020年提交的A1222申请公开了Yarrowia lipolytica利用葡萄糖/蔗糖等简单糖生产Reb MD的路线，后续包括热处理、离心/微滤/澄清、可选超滤、树脂吸附、离子交换、脱色、结晶及母液回收。[7] 该申请B.5.3写明发酵pH为4.5—6.5，发酵后75—95°C、5分钟至1小时热处理；这些属于申请人所描述的商业制造方案范围，公开段落没有对应罐容和批量，不能当作任何菌株的通用发酵/灭活标准。[7] 它仍有工程价值：上游产物浓度和下游蛋白负荷决定精制要求，不能把叶提设备图直接换上“发酵”二字。

**有文件支持的组成变化案例。**A1222明确说明结晶可进行第二次，母液中的糖苷还可浓缩、重新溶解结晶，并可把符合规格的Reb MD批次复配。[7] 因而同样的“总糖苷≥95%”可能来自不同单体组成，工艺切段或母液回用变化可影响最终谱。QA若只设置总量放行，会看不到影响溶解与感官的批间变化；实际应设置关键单体范围或双方认可的谱图，并把回用上限与组成趋势放进变更控制。

zh.heading: 检测与法规：总量、单体谱和来源匹配一起验收

blocks.text: JECFA数据库2019年评估说明四种生产方法所得符合既有规格、糖苷含量≥95%的产品适用其评估框架，并列出ADI为0—4 mg/kg体重、以甜菊醇计。[6] 这里的95%不是“所有市售甜菊复配粉必须有95%糖苷”，ADI也不是某种糖苷按原质量直接使用的每日剂量。与赤藓糖醇、麦芽糊精等复配后，应分开评价原始添加剂的规格和成品的使用量、配料声明。

**可审计的计算例，不是配方建议。**A1222表列甜菊醇分子量318.46，Reb A为967.01，Reb M为1291.3。[7] 若假设配方每天实际摄入纯Reb A为100 mg，其甜菊醇当量约为100×318.46/967.01=32.9 mg；纯Reb M同为100 mg时约为24.7 mg。混合物应将每种糖苷的实际质量乘各自分子量比后相加，再除体重与ADI比较；还要结合其他食品来源。计算只用于说明相同粉重不等于相同甜菊醇暴露，不用于推荐摄入量。

FDA进口警示45-06的2025年文本把传统食品中的甜叶菊叶和粗提物与有关GRAS通知所覆盖的精制糖苷区分；其明确说明叶和粗提物不是获批食品添加剂，也不因名称为stevia就被视为GRAS。[24] 因此清晰文件链应是具体材料→生产路线→对应通知或准入身份→实际食品用途，而不是一张“FDA certified”图。该警示也区分膳食补充剂的监管背景，不能从普通食品限制直接推出全部其他用途结论。[24]
FSANZ A1268已经批准特定加工酶用途，报告描述了最终糖苷中无残余生产微生物/酶蛋白或DNA的申请材料结论；这一结论支持理解相应纯化验证目标，不表示每个发酵或酶转化供应商自动满足同样结果。[8] A1222在本文中是申请人技术档案，不把“提交申请”写成监管批准。最终采购放行应核对当地现行食品类别、糖苷身份、酶/生产菌许可和检测要求；中国和欧盟现行附录的完整逐条核验不在此次已完成证据中。
QA方法包应明确可计入总量的糖苷清单、各标准品或响应因子、干基、样品前处理和未知峰处理。A1222说明为更高糖基化的Reb M和D优化检测方法，而不是只沿用只覆盖较少主要糖苷的旧法。[7] 这提示“旧法总糖苷偏低”可能是方法覆盖不足，“总量合格但感官不稳”可能是单体组成漂移，二者应分别调查。残留溶剂应覆盖实际使用过的乙醇/甲醇等，不根据成品无气味免测；载体或其他甜味剂要进入成分平衡。

blocks.text: 酶与发酵路线的重要性是改变稀有糖苷的获得方式，而不仅是给叶提取加上新标签。2021年综述讨论糖苷生物合成、微生物生产和酶转化研究；A1268与A1222分别提供转化与发酵的具体文件对象。[37][8][7] 对工程评价，滴度、生产速率、底物转化率、最终糖苷组成和精制回收必须联动：上游目标物比例提高可能减少结晶分离负担，但菌体、培养基和蛋白的去除又产生叶提路线没有的负荷。

en.heading: Process: four routes, not one generic “stevia extract”

blocks.text: Total steviol glycosides describe refinement; individual Reb A/D/M proportions describe composition; manufacturing route describes the origin and transformation of the material. These should remain separate specifications.[7][8] FSANZ A1268 summarizes the JECFA framework as leaf extraction, microbial fermentation, enzyme conversion of major to minor glycosides, and additional enzyme-catalyzed glucosylation.[8]

blocks.text: Producing an enzyme by fermentation does not mean that the resulting glycoside was made by direct fermentation from sugar. Drying cannot chemically convert Reb A into Reb M; selective crystallization, mother-liquor recovery and blending can change proportions without bioconversion.[7][8]

For a leaf route, the proposed sampling chain is identity/moisture → milling/extraction → clarification → decolorization/desalting/enrichment → crystallization → drying/blending. Measure glycoside mass through extraction, color/ionic impurity removal alongside product loss during purification, and individual composition in both crystals and mother liquor. The 2024 review supports the variety of extraction and purification technologies, not a single universal optimum.[34]

A 2025 ultrasound/resin paper abstract reports 20% ethanol, 50°C and a 1:10 material/liquid ratio.[36] The retrieved material did not sufficiently establish batch mass and the yield denominator; therefore its yield percentages are not converted into kilograms per kilogram of leaves or used for equipment quotation. Its useful message is the need to optimize extraction and downstream purification together.[36]

A1268 is a 2023 FSANZ approval concerning specific enzymes produced by engineered E. coli K-12: UTP-glucose-1-phosphate uridylyltransferase, UDP-glucosyltransferase and sucrose synthase. The report states that all three are used for the applicant’s Reb M, while two are used for its Reb I.[8] A process brief should consequently track donor-related chemistry, remaining substrates, intermediate glycosides, target product and protein removal, not merely final total assay.

Avansya’s 2020 A1222 application describes Yarrowia lipolytica fermentation of simple sugars, followed by heat treatment, centrifugation/microfiltration/clarification, optional ultrafiltration, resin adsorption, ion exchange, decolorization, crystallization and mother-liquor recovery.[7] Section B.5.3 gives fermentation pH 4.5–6.5 and subsequent heat treatment of 75–95°C for 5 minutes to 1 hour. These are applicant-specific commercial process ranges; the public passage provides no corresponding vessel or batch size and is not a universal fermentation or kill-step standard.[7]

en.heading: Testing and regulation

blocks.text: JECFA’s 2019 database entry describes the four-method framework for qualifying products containing ≥95% steviol glycosides and an ADI of 0–4 mg/kg body weight expressed as steviol.[6] This does not require every retail carrier blend to contain 95% glycosides, nor does it mean the ADI can be applied directly to the unconverted mass of every glycoside.

Illustrative calculation, not a formulation recommendation: A1222 lists molecular weights of 318.46 for steviol, 967.01 for Reb A and 1291.3 for Reb M.[7] Hypothetical daily intake of 100 mg pure Reb A gives approximately 32.9 mg steviol equivalents; 100 mg pure Reb M gives approximately 24.7 mg. Sum the actual masses of individual glycosides multiplied by their own molecular-weight factors, then divide by body weight and consider other dietary sources. Equal powder mass does not mean equal steviol exposure.

FDA Import Alert 45-06, published in its examined form in 2025, distinguishes conventional-food use of stevia leaf/crude extract from refined glycosides covered by relevant GRAS notices. Leaf and crude extracts are neither approved food additives nor considered GRAS merely because they are called stevia.[24] The traceable chain is exact material → manufacturing route → corresponding regulatory record → actual food use. The alert separately discusses supplements, so conventional-food restrictions should not be mechanically generalized to all uses.[24]

A1268 approved particular processing-enzyme uses and reports the absence of residual production-organism/enzyme protein or DNA in the assessed purified product.[8] This describes an applicant-specific assessment, not an automatic conclusion for every supplier. A1222 is used here as a technical application, not proof that submission equals approval. Current local food categories, enzyme/strain permissions and specifications require material-specific confirmation; a complete current China/EU legal annex crosswalk was not completed.

The QA method should define which glycosides enter the total, standards/response factors, dry basis, sample preparation and unknown peaks. A1222 describes optimization to cover more highly glycosylated Reb M/D rather than relying on an older limited-profile method.[7] Incomplete analytical coverage and true compositional drift are different investigations. Solvent testing should follow actual ethanol/methanol and other process history, while carriers and additional sweeteners belong in the composition balance.

The 2021 biosynthesis review and the two FSANZ document sets provide complementary scientific and process contexts.[37][8][7] Titer, productivity, conversion, target proportion and downstream recovery must be considered together: richer target composition may simplify crystallization, while cell/protein/medium removal creates additional load.

blocks.text: 植物与合成路线证据分别来自原始虎杖论文和EFSA意见；微生物来源的存在在2022年欧盟修订法规题名和已检索记录中得到确认，但本次未取得该法规完整附录，故不在此列它的全部限量。[41][20][18]

**公开植物工艺实例：100 g虎杖干根，不是工业SOP。**Wang、Liu、Chen的原始论文用约40目干根粉100 g，以95%乙醇按1:6（g/mL）浸泡约12小时，在约80°C回流，每次1小时，共三次，合并液在65°C真空旋转蒸发至干。[41] 论文的干提取物得率13.3%、提取物中白藜芦醇3.3%，这两个百分比的分母不同：前者相对原根粉，后者相对干提取物，不能都称作“提取率”。[41] 研发计算应保持原料、提取物、目标化合物三级质量账。

随后该研究把干提取物粉碎，以1:30（g/mL）加水，在50°C超声浴20分钟后过滤；水相用盐酸调到pH 1，于75°C回流水解8小时，使虎杖苷转为白藜芦醇。[41] 原料中的糖苷前体贡献新增游离白藜芦醇，因此作者所述约四倍增产是该转化路径的结果，不等于原有游离分子的回收率达到400%。[41] 这里的物料变化是化学去糖；工艺验证要同时跟踪虎杖苷消失、白藜芦醇生成和降解/未知峰出现，不能只看目标峰上升。
论文随后以液液萃取实现分配，采用等体积有机/水相并重复萃取三次，再以pH 8—9的碱性水液洗涤有机相，例示5%碳酸氢钠溶液，约两次等体积洗涤。[41] 研究最终产品白藜芦醇含量超过73.8%；这不是市场常见高纯反式单体等级，后续研究用制备HPLC分离主成分做质谱和核磁确认，也不能把分析确证得到的单体纯度倒算为整批最终产物纯度。[41]

**为什么先干燥再重分散？**同一论文比较过把乙醇浓缩液直接加水过滤与先制成干提取物、再水分散过滤。作者观察到前者较难去除部分低极性成分，提出其可能仍以分子状态存在，而后者的聚集状态更利于滤除；该解释在文中是作者推测，并没有把所有相关图展示出来。[41] 对工程师的启示是过滤不仅取决于滤材孔径，也取决于上游溶剂置换和颗粒形成历史。若希望取消干燥以节能，应以杂质去除和目标损失证明替代流程等效，不能只比较蒸汽账。
**合成路线对照。**EFSA审查的特定合成反式白藜芦醇由Wittig反应及脱甲基步骤制备，涉及三甲氧基中间体、氯化铝与二异丙胺，随后从异丙醇/水结晶并以乙醇/水重结晶。[20] 因此该路线必须关注合成相关结构杂质和试剂残留，而不是套用虎杖的“大黄素检测”就认为完整。这里是申请材料的生产过程描述，公开意见未给每步批量、反应温度等可供直接制造的完整条件。[20]

blocks.text: 表中是工程建议，100 g研究确实使用蒸馏烧瓶、超声浴、旋转蒸发与分液漏斗，这些实验设备证明操作概念，不证明连续装置的传质或停留分布。[41] 放大应重算换热、物料腐蚀性、接触和沉降负荷；工业容积不是把实验分钟数按公斤直接乘倍数。涉及易燃溶剂和酸碱时，应把安全和废液处理作为设备边界，不把论文“eco-friendly”结论原样转为企业环境绩效。
**真实失败案例一：同样pH，不同酸。**虎杖论文作者先采用pH 1硫酸，观察到白藜芦醇和虎杖苷在该条件下易被氧化，随后改用pH 1盐酸回流水解。[41] 该观察不能证明所有硫酸体系必然如此，但足以否定“pH相同即可任意替换酸”的放大假设。需要复核酸种、杂质、溶解氧、金属接触和停留时间，而不是只校准pH计。

**真实失败案例二：检测信号掩盖降解。**2015年Zupančič等对反式白藜芦醇的pH和温度稳定性研究发现，酸性下较稳定，在其试验中pH超过6.8后降解加速；在碱性、光照、较高温度等不稳定条件下，UV/VIS法会给出虚高的反式浓度，而HPLC和UPLC经过专属性确认。[30] 本次取得的是摘要，没有完整溶液批量、浓度和所有时间条件，所以pH 6.8只是该研究的观察节点，不是所有配方的统一禁用边界。工程结论是长期溶出和细胞实验同样需要测暴露液中真实trans含量。

blocks.text: 高纯度与水中可用状态是两个独立指标。2015年研究正是为了澄清白藜芦醇溶解度和稳定性对递送研究的影响；不能把提高pH带来的表观溶解变化与稳定的目标浓度混为一谈。[30] 工程建议让应用团队首先确定目标是胶囊/片剂、悬浮或乳化体系、澄清饮料还是外用配制物，再决定采购普通晶体、微粒化粉或载体规格。

blocks.text: 这些是应用实验方案，不是已做完的本公司配方。对于载体包埋，必须将“负载率”“包封率”“每份trans投料量”“可检出的游离trans”分开定义；否则两个都写“10%”的规格可能一个指质量分数，另一个指包封效率。供应商应提供测法与物料组成，品牌则应以成品证据决定任何功能叙述。配方中增加抗氧化辅助物或避光包装也不自动免除稳定性检测，因为目标物可能发生异构化或其他降解。[30]
建议的打样矩阵以同一原料批为起点：原粉、候选载体、载体空白；分别在最终pH和包装下做避光/受光、常规储存/加速应力，记录总量、trans专属含量、已识别/未知降解峰及物态变化。若只发现上清含量下降而总量未变，优先调查析晶与吸附；若总trans也下降，则调查降解或异构化。两类问题对应不同措施，前者可能调整溶剂/载体和浓度，后者需控制接触历史与包装。

zh.heading: 质量标准与法规：旧授权、现行条目和实验纯度不应混同

blocks.text: 2016年欧盟实施决定2016/1190的历史授权针对附录定义的trans-resveratrol，在成人胶囊或片剂补充剂中最高150 mg/日，并规定相应标示条件；其附录当时列反式含量不低于99%、总相关物不高于0.5%、单一相关物不高于0.1%等。[19] 这些数字可说明“身份、用途和杂质一起构成授权对象”，但不能作为所有来源、所有食品形式及2026年所有当前规格的概括。2022/672又对微生物来源规格作修订，本文获得法规身份和部分文本而非完整现行合并清单，所以采购准入还需核对最新Union list对应条目。[18]

**QA的真实案例比空泛“符合标准”更有用。**EFSA合成来源意见表2中三批汞结果以≤1.0 mg/kg报告，而对应规格为≤0.1 mg/kg，意见明确指出批检结果不能满足该规格。[20] 这不应被改写为“已经测得每批汞都实际超标1 mg/kg”：报告值的粒度不足以证明符合较低限量，是否真实超标需更低定量限方法复测。可直接落实为供应商验收规则：实验室方法/报告限应足以判断规格，不能拿一个高于规格的“未超过”数字作合格证明。
白藜芦醇含量应以能分离顺反异构体和相关杂质的色谱方法测定；单纯UV吸收测定在不稳定条件下的虚高已有实验依据。[30] 虎杖路线可把虎杖苷、大黄素和其他蒽醌/未知峰纳入指纹与清除验证；该100 g研究用C18色谱，并以外标、质谱及核磁对主成分确认。[41] 合成路线则根据其反应历史看类似物和二异丙胺等，EFSA意见使用特定方法和限量，但不是所有生产路线的默认杂质清单。[20]
批证还应标明原样/干基、水分、灰分、残留溶剂、载体和每份实际活性量。示例计算：若1 g配制物标示10% trans且含量基准确实为整个原样制备物，则名义投料为100 mg；若10%是干基或指包封率，计算就不能直接成立。这是计量示例，不是用量推荐。对于植物来源，不应以分子相同为由抹去植物部位、提取溶剂、前体水解和来源相关杂质的信息。

zh.heading: 科研意义：从“抗氧化故事”转为可重现暴露与选择性工艺

blocks.text: 虎杖论文的实际科研价值在于把溶解性、酸性和水解性质串成可检测的工艺步骤，并给出各段质量变化；它最终获得约73.8%级别产品，也让研发看见选择性与纯度还存在距离。[41] 稳定性论文的价值在于揭示实验方法可能测到错误的目标浓度；对长时间细胞培养或溶出测试，取样点的真实化学组成应进入结果解释。[30] EFSA意见则把来源、杂质、暴露量和毒理证据放在同一个评价对象中，而不是仅凭天然存在就推断高摄入安全。[20]

en.heading: Process: common molecule, source-specific impurities

blocks.text: Resveratrol is not synonymous with grape-seed extract. Botanical preparations may contain resveratrol, its glycoside precursor and other constituents; purified trans-resveratrol is a molecularly defined material; synthetic and microbial sources create different process and regulatory identities. The knotweed study follows resveratrol, polydatin/piceid and emodin, whereas EFSA’s synthetic-material assessment identifies related synthetic compounds and residual diisopropylamine.[41][20]
